==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|prize||obsolete}} {{defdate|16th–19th c.}}

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|price||price, prize, value, excellence}}, borrowed from {{der|en|fro|pris}}, {{m|fro|preis}}, from {{der|en|la|pretium||worth, price, money spent, wages, reward}}; compare [[praise]], [[precious]], [[appraise]], [[appreciate]], [[depreciate]], etc.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈpɹaɪ̯s/|a=RP,GA}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-price.ogg|a=US}}
** {{audio|en|En-uk-price.ogg|a=UK}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈpɹɐɪ̯s/|/ˈpɹɜɪ̯s/|/ˈpɹʌɪ̯s/|/ˈpɹəɪ̯s/|a=CA,Canadian raising}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈpɹɑ̟ɪ̯s/|/ˈpɹɒ̈ɪ̯s/|a=AU,NZ}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈpɹaːs/|a=[[w:Southern accent (United States)|Inland Southern US]],ZA,[[w:Monophthongization|/aɪ̯/-ungliding]]}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈpɹɛɪs/|a=Northumbria}}
* {{rhymes|en|aɪs|s=1}}
* {{hyph|en|price}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# The [[cost]] [[require]]d to gain [[possession]] of something.
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Love's Labour's Lost|I|ii|passage=We can afford no more at such a '''price'''.}}
#* {{RQ:Lincoln Pratt's Patients|chapter=3|passage=My hopes wa'n't disappointed. I never saw clams thicker than they was along them inshore flats. I filled my dreener in no time, and then it come to me that 'twouldn't be a bad idee to get a lot more, take 'em with me to Wellmouth, and peddle 'em out. Clams was fairly scarce over that side of the bay and ought to fetch a fair '''price'''.}}
# The [[cost]] of an action or [[deed]].
#: {{ux|en|I paid a high '''price''' for my folly.}} 
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1941|author=w:George Orwell|url=https://www.orwellfoundation.com/the-orwell-foundation/orwell/essays-and-other-works/the-lion-and-the-unicorn-socialism-and-the-english-genius/|title=The Lion and the Unicorn
|passage=It is difficult otherwise to explain the contradictions of [Chamberlain’s] policy, his failure to grasp any of the courses that were open to him. Like the mass of the people, he did not want to pay the '''price''' either of peace or of war.}} 
# Value; estimation; excellence; worth.
#* {{RQ:KJV|Proverbs|xxxi|10|text=Her '''price''' is far above rubies.}}
#* {{RQ:Keble Christian Year|text=new treasures still, of countless '''price'''}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[determine]] the [[monetary]] value of (an item); to put a price on.
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[find out]] what something costs
#: {{ux|en|We '''price'''d a few laptops before deciding which one to buy.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive|obsolete}} To [[pay]] the price of; to make [[reparation]] for.
#* {{RQ:Spenser Faerie Queene|I|ix|passage=Thou damned wight, / The author of this fact, we here behold, / What iustice can but iudge against thee right, / With thine owne bloud to '''price''' his bloud, here shed in sight.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive|obsolete}} To set a price on; to [[value]]; to [[prize]].
#: {{syn|en|esteem|evaluate|worthen|Thesaurus:appraise}}
# {{lb|en|transitive|colloquial|dated}} To ask the price of.
#: {{ux|en|to '''price''' eggs}}
